::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 1 Chronicles reviews Israel's history with emphasis on David, worship, and God's covenant promises. The book encourages God's people to remain faithful in worship and trust His enduring purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
1 Chronicles 1:1
Adam
### Why This Verse Opening of biblical genealogy ### Chapter Insight This chapter traces humanity's genealogy from Adam to the nations. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereign oversight of history and peoples. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
1 Chronicles 2:55
Families of the scribes
### Why This Verse Memorable genealogical note ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the genealogy of Judah. The key verse highlights the tribe through which God's covenant promises would unfold. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
1 Chronicles 3:17
Jeconiah's descendants
### Why This Verse Messianic genealogy importance ### Chapter Insight This chapter traces the royal line of David. The key verse emphasizes God's preservation of the Davidic dynasty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
1 Chronicles 4:10
Prayer of Jabez
### Why This Verse Most famous verse in Chronicles ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues genealogies and includes the prayer of Jabez. The key verse highlights dependence upon God's blessing and guidance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
1 Chronicles 5:20
They cried to God in battle
### Why This Verse Victory through dependence ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the genealogies of the eastern tribes. The key verse emphasizes that victory comes through trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
1 Chronicles 6:31
David appointed singers
### Why This Verse Beginning of temple music emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter traces the lineage and duties of the Levites. The key verse highlights the importance of worship and service before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
1 Chronicles 7:23
He called his name Beriah
### Why This Verse Notable family account ### Chapter Insight This chapter records genealogies of several northern tribes. The key verse demonstrates God's preservation of His covenant people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
1 Chronicles 8:33
Saul begat Jonathan
### Why This Verse Links genealogy to kingdom history ### Chapter Insight This chapter focuses on the tribe of Benjamin. The key verse prepares for the introduction of Saul's family line. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
1 Chronicles 9:22
Chosen gatekeepers
### Why This Verse Temple service emphasis ### Chapter Insight This chapter records those who returned from exile and served in Jerusalem. The key verse emphasizes restoration and renewed worship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
1 Chronicles 10:13
Saul died for his transgression
### Why This Verse Divine explanation of Saul's death ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Saul's death. The key verse explains that Saul's downfall resulted from unfaithfulness to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
1 Chronicles 11:9
David waxed greater and greater
### Why This Verse Summary of David's rise ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's rise as king over all Israel. The key verse highlights God's establishment of David according to His promise. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
1 Chronicles 12:32
Men who understood the times
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted leadership verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter lists those who supported David. The key verse emphasizes unity in advancing God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
1 Chronicles 13:10
Uzzah put forth his hand
### Why This Verse Reverence for God's holiness ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the unsuccessful attempt to move the ark. The key verse highlights the importance of approaching God according to His instructions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
1 Chronicles 14:11
God has broken through my enemies
### Why This Verse Baal-perazim ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes David's victories and growing kingdom. The key verse emphasizes that God established David for the sake of His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
1 Chronicles 15:13
We sought Him not after the due order
### Why This Verse Lesson from Uzzah incident ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the proper transport of the ark. The key verse demonstrates worship carried out in obedience to God's commands. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
1 Chronicles 16:11
Seek the LORD and His strength
### Why This Verse Widely quoted worship verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates the ark's arrival in Jerusalem. The key verse calls God's people to remember and proclaim His works. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
1 Chronicles 17:14
I will establish him forever
### Why This Verse Davidic covenant reaffirmed ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's covenant with David. The key verse promises an enduring kingdom and points to the coming Messiah. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
1 Chronicles 18:14
David executed judgment and justice
### Why This Verse Summary of righteous rule ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes David's military victories. The key verse emphasizes that the Lord gave victory wherever David went. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
1 Chronicles 19:13
Be strong and let us behave ourselves valiantly
### Why This Verse Joab's exhortation ### Chapter Insight This chapter records conflict with Ammon and Syria. The key verse highlights courage and trust in God's sovereignty. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
1 Chronicles 20:8
These were born to the giant
### Why This Verse Closing victory summary ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues David's military successes. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness in securing victory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
1 Chronicles 21:13
Let me fall into the hand of the LORD
### Why This Verse David's repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts David's census and repentance. The key verse emphasizes reliance upon God's mercy rather than human strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
1 Chronicles 22:13
Be strong and of good courage
### Why This Verse David's charge to Solomon ### Chapter Insight This chapter records David's preparations for the Temple. The key verse highlights devotion to God's future work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
1 Chronicles 23:30
Praise and thank the LORD morning and evening
### Why This Verse Worship duty ### Chapter Insight This chapter organizes the Levites for Temple service. The key verse emphasizes orderly worship and faithful stewardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
1 Chronicles 24:19
Order of priestly service
### Why This Verse Organization of priesthood ### Chapter Insight This chapter arranges the priestly divisions. The key verse demonstrates God's order in ministry and worship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
1 Chronicles 25:7
Trained in singing unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Temple music ministry ### Chapter Insight This chapter organizes musicians for Temple worship. The key verse highlights the role of praise in serving God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
1 Chronicles 26:20
Treasures of the house of God
### Why This Verse Stewardship responsibility ### Chapter Insight This chapter appoints gatekeepers and treasurers. The key verse emphasizes faithful administration of God's work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
1 Chronicles 27:1
Divisions serving month by month
### Why This Verse National organization ### Chapter Insight This chapter records military and governmental organization. The key verse demonstrates wise leadership and accountability. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
1 Chronicles 28:9
If thou seek Him, He will be found
### Why This Verse David's charge to Solomon ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains David's charge to Solomon. The key verse urges wholehearted devotion and obedience to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
1 Chronicles 29:11
Thine, O LORD, is the greatness
### Why This Verse One of Scripture's great doxologies ### Chapter Insight This chapter records offerings for the Temple and David's final prayer. The key verse acknowledges that all blessings and resources come from God. :::
